standard_prerequisites.name: The two first-order model operators and their domains
standard_prerequisites.statement: The operators eq D0+ P and eq D0- 1-P acting on L^2(tilde S_C^+), with the positive function h on the cylinder.
standard_prerequisites.use: The pair the proposition relates; declared as the article's standing notation, no external stub beyond the two operator-display stubs.

core_obligations: State the adjointness (statement lines 1197-1200): if h has a positive lower bound, then the two operators eq D0+ P and eq D0- 1-P are each other's adjoints.

Reproduce the argument (proof lines 1201-1228): prove the pairing identity eq adjoints DC 1 on the W^1 domains by tensor decomposition s_P = s_P^N tensor f_P, self-adjointness of D_N^+ and integration by parts; decompose further by the eigenspaces of D_N^+ and use the boundary conditions (positive-eigenvalue components of f_P and negative-eigenvalue components of f_{1-P} vanish at zero) to kill the boundary term (eq adjoints DC 2); extend the identity from the dense set of sections sigma_P = tilde D_C^+ s_P, sigma_{1-P} = tilde D_C^- s_{1-P} by boundedness of the inverse operators, and conclude (tilde D_C^+)^* = tilde D_C^-.
proof_roadmap: Prove the pairing identity by tensor decomposition and integration by parts (proof lines 1202-1215).
Kill the boundary term by the eigenspace decomposition and the boundary conditions (proof lines 1216).
Extend by density and bounded inverses to conclude (tilde D_C^+)^* = tilde D_C^- (proof lines 1218-1228).
